html, body, #map { height: 100%; width: 100%; margin: 0; }
#sifric-wordmark {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: max(.65rem, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  left: max(.75rem, env(safe-area-inset-left));
  z-index: 1;
  pointer-events: none;
  width: clamp(3rem, 18vw, 4.5rem);
  aspect-ratio: 288 / 88;
  background: url("data:image/webp;base64,") center / contain no-repeat;
  opacity: .84;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 2px #000b);
}
#map .maplibregl-ctrl-bottom-right {
  max-width: calc(100% - clamp(4rem, 18vw + 1rem, 5.5rem));
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
button#sifric-wordmark[aria-expanded="false"] { pointer-events: auto; cursor: pointer; }
button#sifric-wordmark { border: 0; padding: 0; }
#sifric-credits[hidden] { display: none; }
#status { position: absolute; inset: auto 1rem 1rem; padding: .75rem; background: white; font: 1rem system-ui; }
#appearance {
  position: absolute;
  top: .75rem;
  left: .75rem;
  max-width: calc(100% - 4.5rem);
  padding: .5rem;
  border-radius: .5rem;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 6px #0004;
}
#appearance:not([hidden]) { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem; }
#appearance, #status { background: #fff; color: #202124; font: .875rem system-ui; }
#appearance label { display: grid; gap: .2rem; }
#appearance select { font: inherit; padding: .3rem; border: 1px solid #9aa0a6; border-radius: .25rem; }
:root[data-theme="dark"] { color-scheme: dark; }
:root[data-theme="dark"] #appearance, :root[data-theme="dark"] #status { background: #202124; color: #e8eaed; }
